purpose: Provides lightweight camera-distance culling using spatial cells and render-state restoration.
description: CameraCulling tracks tagged instances in spatial cells and exposes manual, automatic, and observable culling controls.

CameraCulling.luau.description: Tracks camera-distance culling for tagged instances and restores their render state.

CameraCullingUtils.luau.description: Derives culling bounds, cell coordinates, and camera-distance decisions.
